text: flushToHost (4740 commands): RangeError: Invalid string length at JSON.stringify — editor command bridge crashing on an oversized flush
resolution: The editor command bridge crashed when a coalesced flush exceeded V8/QuickJS's ~2^29-char string limit: JSON.stringify threw RangeError and flushToHost dropped the ENTIRE batch, freezing/desyncing the editor. Fixed in renderer/hostConfig.ts: flushCoalesced serializes the batch and, if it won't stringify, bisects and flushes each half in order (the host applies batches sequentially so a split is transparent) — the editor no longer hard-fails on size. Because a 4740-command, half-gigabyte flush means something upstream is dumping MBs into the command stream (a prop carrying mesh verts / instance arrays / a paint atlas), oversized flushes now log [flush-oversize] with the top commands by byte size + their prop keys, and an un-splittable single command is named — surfacing the real bloat for a targeted follow-up instead of hiding it. Safety net committed; root-cause prop still to be identified from the diagnostic.
